policy: Unreviewed business and SQL database imports are migration debt. Reviewed repositories must retain scoped, detached and staged data access. Durability-only modules may import only their declared fence exports; reintroducing reads, writes or SQL fails the gate.

approvedScopedImporters.server/org/durable_routes.ts: Organization-scoped snapshots, serialized writes and row-version compensation.
approvedScopedImporters.server/persistence/settings_repository.t: Settings-table value access only; declared-key transactions are staged before writeDB accepts them. Durable writes restore only a still-current failed value.
approvedScopedImporters.server/memory/repository.ts: Owned memory/reminder row values only; detached reads, staged single-row updates, immutable ownership, and same-lane parent validation before write acceptance.
approvedScopedImporters.server/conversation/history_repository.t: Owner-filtered detached interaction history, bounded conversation display metadata, authorization status only, staged plain-message append; no database/row callbacks or task writes.
approvedScopedImporters.server/tts/profile_store.ts: Personal/organization keyed voice profiles, detached snapshots, staged writes with immutable owner identity; provider metadata getter returns model string only.
approvedScopedImporters.server/llm/model_routing_receipts.ts: Declared model receipt append and per-user retention staged before writeDB; detached owned receipts, global provider observation returns bounded status metadata only.
approvedScopedImporters.server/llm/token_tracker.ts: Token-usage table append staged before writeDB; detached rows for an exact user; anonymous never grants instance-wide access.
